name: Invincible Big Cat
detailed_description:
Invincible Big Cat is a Survivors-like game. You will play as the last kitten trapped on the Mouse Planet, living in humiliation in the zoo, surrounded and mocked by mice. Until one day, the evil and charismatic cosmic pirate Dr. Cat appears and genetically modifies you, evolving you into Meowsilla, possessing invincible powers.

Now it's time for your revenge!

Game Features

  • Eighties retro art style
    Enjoy the unique charm brought by the nostalgic visual effects of the 80s.
  • Exciting combat system
    The game features exhilarating hack-and-slash action design, allowing you to use your claws to shred everything in front of you!
  • Destroy everything
    Become the ruthless Meowsilla and destroy everything in the city.
  • Mice and more mice
    A variety of mice and monsters await you to tear them apart.
  • Fun memes and story performances
    Perhaps you can discover some familiar buildings or stories during the game.
  • Ignite the flames of your revenge
    Let the whole world burn in your wrath!
